findings.evidence: The deleted `topologicalKrullDim_spec_eq_zero` had a four-line comment justifying its `change`; the new lemma has none. Grep for `topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim` in this file hits 148, 170 and 185 with `Spec` carriers; line 185 has no comment at all. The same inline pattern appears at `Morphisms/RelativeDimension.lean:310` and `:314`, and `Curves/TwoChartModel/Regular.lean:156`.
findings.fix: Add a comment saying that the carrier of `Spec R` is `PrimeSpectrum R` by definition (`Scheme.Spec_carrier`) and that no lemma bridges this. Then use `topologicalKrullDim_Spec` at lines 146-148, 170 and 185, so the defeq is crossed only here in this file.
findings.issue: `topologicalKrullDim_Spec` is proved by the bare term `PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim R`, which typechecks only through the undocumented defeq between the carrier of `Spec R` and `PrimeSpectrum R`. The PR removes the comment in `Trivial.lean` that explained this, and lines 146-148, 170 and 185 of the same file still use the raw defeq.

findings.evidence: All three sites run `rw [← aeval_comp_rename]` then `AlgHom.Finite.comp _ (AlgHom.Finite.of_surjective _ (rename_surjective _ e.surjective))`. Grep for `aeval_comp_rename|rename_surjective|finite_aeval` found no existing lemma stating this.
findings.fix: Extract one lemma, e.g. `(aeval (R := R) x).Finite → Function.Surjective e → (aeval (R := R) (x ∘ e)).Finite`, and use it at all three sites.
findings.issue: The new `hx'` block repeats a general fact inline: `(aeval x).Finite` implies `(aeval (x ∘ e)).Finite` for surjective `e`. The same argument is already at `AlgebraicGeometry/AffineSpace/NoetherNormalization.lean:84-87` and `Examples/AlgebraicGeometry/AffineSpace/NoetherNormalization.lean:108-112`.

findings.evidence: `AffineSpace/Basic.lean` has `homOfAlgebra_inj` but no existence counterpart. The inline block (`φ`, the `Algebra` instance, `x`, `haeval`, `hφ_eq`, `hι`) is about a third of the proof.
findings.fix: Extract it as a lemma over a `CommRing` base, e.g. `[IsAffine Z] (ι) : ∃ (_ : Algebra R Γ(Z, ⊤)) (x : n → Γ(Z, ⊤)), ι = Z.isoSpec.hom ≫ homOfAlgebra R x`, next to `homOfAlgebra_inj` in `AffineSpace/Basic.lean`, and `obtain` it here.
findings.issue: Lines 130-142 of `exists_linear_normalization_of_isFinite` prove a reusable fact inline: for affine `Z`, any `ι : Z ⟶ 𝔸(n; Spec (.of k))` is `Z.isoSpec.hom ≫ homOfAlgebra k x` for an induced algebra structure on `Γ(Z, ⊤)`. It uses neither finiteness of `ι` (beyond `Z` affine), nor `Infinite k`, nor that `k` is a field.

summary: The new bridge lemma `topologicalKrullDim_Spec` rests on an undocumented carrier defeq (the PR deletes the comment that explained it), and other proofs in its file still cross the same gap by hand. Two reusable steps are also left inline: finiteness of `aeval` under surjective reindexing, and recovering `homOfAlgebra` from an arbitrary morphism.
